papers.title: Ablate-to-Validate: Are Vision-Language Models Really Using Continuous Thought Tokens?
papers.authors: Tianyi Zhang, Mahtab Bigverdi, Ranjay Krishna
papers.affiliations: University of Washington
papers.intro: 本文提出 Token Replacement Test（TRT），通过系统性地替换连续视觉 token 内容（零、随机、首重复、真值等）来诊断 VLM 是否真正利用 token 信息，并在多个 backbone 和现成系统上发现准确率提升是误导性代理——模型几乎不依赖 token 内容。

papers.title: Flat-Pack Bench: Evaluating Spatio-Temporal Understanding in Large Vision-Language Models through Furniture Assembly
papers.authors: Aditya Chetan, Eric Cai, Peeyush Kushwaha, Bharath Raj Nagoor Kani, Utkarsh Mall, Qianqian Wang, Noah Snavely, Bharath Hariharan
papers.affiliations: Cornell University, Cornell Tech, MBZUAI, UC Berkeley, Independent researcher
papers.intro: 提出Flat-Pack Bench，一个以家具组装视频为中心的基准，通过四种精细时空推理任务（时序排序、时序定位、部件对接和跟踪）系统评估大型视觉语言模型，揭示其远低于人类水平的严重不足。

papers.title: UniVL: Unified Vision-Language Embedding for Spatially Grounded Contextual Image Generation
papers.authors: Jiayun Wang, Yu Wang, Weijie Gan, Zhenting Wang, Wei Wei
papers.tags: image generation, text-to-image, image-to-image, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: Center for Advanced AI, Accenture
papers.intro: 提出UniVL框架，通过将文本标签直接渲染到掩码区域形成统一视觉条件，利用OCR预训练的视觉编码器生成融合语义与空间位置的UniVL嵌入（fVL），以两阶段训练对齐和微调扩散模型，完全消除独立的文本编码器，实现高效且空间精确的上下文图像生成。

papers.title: MSAVBench: Towards Comprehensive and Reliable Evaluation of Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation
papers.authors: Yujie Wei, Yujin Han, Zhekai Chen, Yongming Li, Kaixun Jiang, Zhihang Liu, Quanhao Li, Zhiwu Qing, Xiang Wang, Zhen Xing, Ruihang Chu, Lingyi Hong, Yefei He, Junjie Zhou, Junqiu Yu, Yang Shi, Difan Zou, Kai Zhu, Shiwei Zhang, Yingya Zhang, Yu Liu, Xihui Liu, Hongming Shan
papers.affiliations: Fudan University, The University of Hong Kong, Tongyi Lab (Alibaba Group), Zhejiang University, Peking University
papers.intro: 提出MSAVBench，第一个全面的多镜头音频-视频生成基准和自适应混合评估框架，覆盖视频、音频、镜头和参考四个维度，包含对19个最新闭源和开源模型的系统评估，与人类判断的Spearman秩相关达91.5%。

papers.title: From Seeing to Thinking: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning Improves Post-Training of Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Juncheng Wu, Hardy Chen, Haoqin Tu, Xianfeng Tang, Freda Shi, Hui Liu, Hanqing Lu, Cihang Xie, Yuyin Zhou
papers.tags: Image Feature Extraction, object detection, image classification
papers.affiliations: 1Amazon, 2UC Santa Cruz, 3University of Waterloo, 4Vector Institute, Canada CIFAR AI Chair
papers.intro: 本文提出一种能力级别的阶段性后训练框架，将VLM的训练解耦为视觉感知、文本推理和视觉推理三个阶段，发现视觉感知需要专用数据、分阶段先于推理训练且更适合用RL而非SFT，从而提升整体性能并缩短推理痕迹。

papers.title: Multi-axis Analysis of Image Manipulation Localization
papers.authors: Keanu Nichols, Divya Appapogu, Giscard Biamby, Dina Bashkirova, Anna Rohrbach, Bryan A. Plummer
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, image classification, Image Feature Extraction, Mask Generation
papers.affiliations: Boston University, University of California, Berkeley, Technical University of Darmstadt & hessian.AI, Google
papers.intro: 本文提出AUDITS，一个大规模、多轴（域、质量、类型、大小）的图像篡改定位基准，涵盖超过53万张来自两个域、11种扩散篡改技术的图像，并发现现有方法在域迁移时性能显著下降且域泛化技术无法改善，突显了该领域的重大挑战。

papers.title: CaMo: Camera Motion Grounded Evaluation and Training for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Hsiang-Wei Huang, Junbin Lu, Kuang-Ming Chen, Jianxu Shangguan, Cheng-Yen Yang, Jenq-Neng Hwang
papers.affiliations: University of Washington
papers.intro: 本文提出Spatial Narrative Score (SNS)诊断性评估框架和CaMo-30K训练数据集，通过显式监督相机运动理解，训练出CaMo-3B模型，实现在直接问答和SNS评估上一致的空间理解性能，揭示了现有空间VLM依赖捷径学习的现象。

papers.title: Rethinking Visual Attribution for Chest X-ray Reasoning in Large Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Guangzhi Xiong, Qiao Jin, Sanchit Sinha, Zhiyong Lu, Aidong Zhang
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, Image Feature Extraction, image classification, image-to-image, image generation
papers.affiliations: University of Virginia, National Institutes of Health
papers.intro: 本文提出一种因果评估框架（MedGround-Bench）证明现有归因方法在胸部X光推理中普遍无法忠实定位LVLM的视觉证据，并设计了一种基于概念的部分最优传输干预归因方法（MedFocus），在空间、概念和词元三个层面显著提升归因忠实性。

papers.title: PixVerve: Advancing Native UHR Image Generation to 100MP with a Large-Scale High-Quality Dataset
papers.authors: Haojun Chen, Haoyang He, Chengming Xu, Qingdong He, Junwei Zhu, Yabiao Wang, Zhucun Xue, Xianfang Zeng, Zhennan Chen, Xiaobin Hu, Hao Zhao, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang, Dacheng Tao
papers.tags: text-to-image, image generation, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: Haojun Chen - 浙江大学, Haoyang He - 浙江大学, Chengming Xu - 复旦大学, Qingdong He - 浙江大学, Junwei Zhu - 南京大学, Yabiao Wang - 浙江大学, Zhucun Xue - 浙江大学, Xianfang Zeng - 浙江大学, Zhennan Chen - 南京大学, Xiaobin Hu - 新加坡国立大学, Hao Zhao - 清华大学, Yong Liu - 浙江大学, Jiangning Zhang - 浙江大学, Dacheng Tao - 南洋理工大学
papers.intro: 本文提出了PixVerve-95K——首个大规模高质量100MP T2I数据集，并基于该数据集探索了多种原生100MP图像生成训练方案，同时构建了PixVerve-Bench评估基准，系统推进了超高清文本到图像生成。

papers.title: SetCon: Towards Open-Ended Referring Segmentation via Set-Level Concept Prediction
papers.authors: Zhixiong Zhang, Yizhuo Li, Shuangrui Ding, Yuhang Zang, Shengyuan Ding, Long Xing, Yibin Wang, Qiaosheng Zhang, Jiaqi Wang
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Fudan University, University of Science and Technology of China
papers.intro: 本文提出SetCon，通过将开放式指代分割重新定义为显式的集合级概念预测，利用LVLM生成的自然语言概念（而非特殊token）作为语义条件进行联合掩码集解码，并引入层级语义分解以处理跨类别场景。

papers.title: MetaEarth-MM: Unified Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Generation with Scene-centered Joint Modeling
papers.authors: Zhiping Yu, Chenyang Liu, Jinqi Cao, Qinzhe Yang, Siwei Yu, Zhengxia Zou, Zhenwei Shi
papers.tags: image generation, image-to-image, Image Feature Extraction, image classification
papers.affiliations: Beihang University (北京航空航天大学)
papers.intro: 本文提出MetaEarth-MM，一个基于场景中心联合建模的统一多模态遥感图像生成基础模型，在流匹配框架下通过解耦的架构（场景推理模块+模态感知路由生成器）实现五种模态（RGB、SAR、NIR、PAN、OSM）的联合生成与任意翻译，并构建了包含280万图像的EarthMM数据集。

papers.title: VL-DPO: Vision-Language-Guided Finetuning for Preference-Aligned Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Zhefan Xu, Ghassen Jerfel, Marina Haliem, Qi Zhao, Jeonhyung Kang, Khaled S. Refaat
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University (Zhefan Xu), Waymo (Ghassen Jerfel, Marina Haliem, Qi Zhao, Jeonhyung Kang, Khaled S. Refaat)
papers.intro: 本文提出VL-DPO，利用冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）作为零样本推理器，自动生成轨迹偏好对，通过直接偏好优化（DPO）微调运动预测模型，实现与人类驾驶偏好的有效对齐。

papers.title: Probability-Conserving Flow Guidance
papers.authors: Parsa Esmati, Junha Hyung, Amirhossein Dadashzadeh, Jaegul Choo, Majid Mirmehdi
papers.affiliations: University of Bristol (Parsa Esmati, Amirhossein Dadashzadeh, Majid Mirmehdi), KAIST (Junha Hyung, Jaegul Choo)
papers.intro: 本文从概率守恒的连续性方程出发，将引导项分解为散度项和分数平行项，提出自适应流形引导（AdaMaG）的即插即用采样规则，通过对两者进行约束（分数平行阻尼+晚期时间衰减）来保持轨迹在流形上，从而在无额外推理成本下改善生成质量。

papers.title: FineBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Fine-grained Human Activity Understanding
papers.authors: Gueter Josmy Faure, Min-Hung Chen, Jia-Fong Yeh, Hung-Ting Su, Winston H. Hsu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, visual question answering, video search
papers.affiliations: National Taiwan University, Google, Independent Researcher
papers.intro: 本文提出了FineBench——一个包含199,420个QA对、基于64个长视频的密集标注人类中心视频问答基准，并提出了FineAgent模块化框架，通过Localizer和Descriptor组件显著提升开放源码VLMs在细粒度人类活动理解上的表现。

papers.title: OpenComputer: Verifiable Software Worlds for Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Jinbiao Wei, Qianran Ma, Yilun Zhao, Xiao Zhou, Kangqi Ni, Guo Gan, Arman Cohan
papers.affiliations: Yale NLP Lab (Yale University), University of Pennsylvania, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
papers.intro: OpenComputer提出了一种以可验证性为核心（verifier-grounded）的框架，能够自动合成包含可执行环境、任务描述和可编程验证器的桌面软件世界，用于规模化构建和评估计算机使用智能体，并通过自进化验证层提高了评估可靠性。

papers.title: Dual-Prompt CLIP with Hybrid Visual Encoders for Occluded Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Zhangjian Ji, Shaotong Qiao, Kai Feng, Wei Wei
papers.affiliations: School of Computer & Information Technology, Shanxi University; Key Laboratory of Computational Intelligence and Chinese Information Processing of Ministry of Education
papers.intro: 本文提出DPL-ReID模型，通过双提示学习（Dual-PL）同时建模完整行人语义和遮挡感知语义，结合真实世界遮挡增强（RWOA）与加权门控特征融合（WGFF），在多个遮挡ReID基准数据集上取得了最先进的性能。

papers.title: Knowing When Not to Predict: Self Supervised Learning and Abstention for Safer DR Screening
papers.authors: Muskaan Chopra, Lorenz Sparrenberg, Jan H. Terheyden, Rafet Sifa
papers.affiliations: Rheinische Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn, Bonn, Germany（作者1,4）；University Hospital Bonn - Department of Ophthalmology, Germany（作者3）；Fraunhofer IAIS, Sankt Augustin, Germany（作者4部分）；Lamarr Institute for Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, Germany（作者4部分）
papers.intro: 本文系统研究了自监督预训练时长如何影响糖尿病视网膜病变筛查中的校准置信度和基于置信度的弃权行为，发现长预训练不单调提升可靠性，选择性性能在准确率饱和后仍会显著变化，强调需将预训练时长作为可靠性相关设计选择来对待。

papers.title: EgoBabyVLM: Benchmarking Cross-Modal Learning from Naturalistic Egocentric Video Data
papers.authors: Dongyan Lin, Phillip Rust, Angel Villar Corrales, Alvin W. M. Tan, Mahi Luthra, Charles-Éric Saint-James, Rashel Moritz, Sheila Krogh-Jespersen, Vanessa Stark, Surya Parimi, Jiayi Shen, Youssef Benchekroun, Yosuke Higuchi, Martin Gleize, Tom Fizycki, Nicolas Hamilakis, Manel Khentout, Sho Tsuji, Balázs Kégl, Juan Pino, Michael C. Frank, Emmanuel Dupoux
papers.affiliations: Meta Superintelligence Labs, Stanford University, Meta Reality Labs, École Normale Supérieure, The University of Tokyo
papers.intro: 本文提出EgoBabyVLM挑战，包括最大规模的自然主义婴儿第一人称视频数据集BabyView（863小时）和自动生成的语料库基语言接地基准Machine-DevBench，实验证明无论是对比式（CLIP+）还是生成式（LLaVA）VLM在自然主义弱对齐数据上均接近随机水平，而精心对齐的数据上则接近…

papers.title: Generation of Heterogeneous PET Images from Uniform Organ Activity Maps Using a Pretrained Domain-Adapted Diffusion Model
papers.authors: Suya Li, Kaushik Dutta, Debojyoti Pal, Jingqin Luo, Kooresh I. Shoghi
papers.affiliations: Washington University School of Medicine; McKelvey School of Engineering, Washington University in St Louis; Washington University School of Medicine; Washington University in St Louis
papers.intro: 本文提出一种预训练域自适应扩散模型（PAD），通过两阶段粗到细训练策略和自然图像预训练文本到图像解码器，实现从均匀器官活动图生成视觉逼真且定量准确的异质性PET图像。

papers.title: FAGER: Factually Grounded Evaluation and Refinement of Text-to-Image Models
papers.authors: Youngsun Lim, Cusuh Ham, Pin-Yu Chen, Deepti Ghadiyaram
papers.tags: text-to-image, image generation, image-to-image, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: Boston University, Adobe, IBM Research, Boston University
papers.intro: 提出FAGER，一个基于智能体的框架，通过结合LLM的事实提议和参考引导的视觉事实提取与验证，构建结构化事实量规并转换为QA对进行VLM评估，同时提供无训练的事实性改进反馈。
